runner_class.name: ubuntu-latest (4 vCPU, amd64)

runner_class.local_runs: advisory only; they never fail a PR

measured_ratios.note: advisory: taken on the developer workstation class (AMD Ryzen 5 9600X, 12 threads, linux/amd64, Go toolchain of this checkout), not on the reference runner; they are ratios only, never absolute times

noisy_neighbor.note: advisory: the bound gates the mean per-step ratio; the worst single-step ratio is recorded as diagnostics only because an 8-step sample is not reproducible across runs; measurements are advisory, taken 2026-11-15 on the developer workstation class, not the reference runner
